link.note: GEDBAS confirms a Mathias Haizler × Ottilia Schirk at the Wehrlehof, Oberried-Vörlinsbach, 1723–24 (children Christian and Eva, 1724); tree's first name 'Martinus' should be Mathias; 1728 deaths unsupported; that they were Jacob Heitzler's parents is unproven (Round 3: Schirk link speculative).

summary: Possible 7th great-grandfather of John; Wehrlehof farmer (correct name Mathias Haizler).
bio: The tree's 'Martinus Heitzler + Othilia Schirk, both d. 1728' corresponds to Mathias Haizler and Ottilia Schirk, who lived at the Wehrlehof in Oberried-Vörlinsbach in 1723–24, where children Christian and Eva were born in 1724 (GEDBAS 1262183134/1262183135). The later Wehrlehof Heitzlers (Andreas b. c.1710 × Ottilia Maier; Andreas b. 1731 × Magdalena Maier; Joseph × Maria Rombach) had 'grown poor' and lived in the farm's Stöckle. Correct 'Martinus' to Mathias.
